Insight Graphics brings graphic design, labels, packaging, and commercial printing together. Based in Kolkata, we help businesses across India turn their requirements into printed materials that represent their brand.

  • Design and artwork support for new requirements.
  • Printing from existing, supplied artwork.
  • Discussion of materials and finishing options.
  • Support for packaging and wider business print needs.

Embellishments & finishes

Finishes that sell on the shelf

The last step is what buyers notice first. Every finish is done in-house, on the same job ticket as your print.

Hot foil stamping

Gold, silver and coloured foils that catch the light on shelf. Made for spirits, personal care and festive packs.

Spot UV & varnish

Gloss, matte or spot UV to protect the print and lift a logo or pattern off the pack.

Lamination

Gloss, matte and soft-touch films that guard against scuffs, moisture and oil.

Die-cutting

Custom shapes for labels, tags and cartons, cut clean to the dieline.

Embossing

Raised logos and textures you can feel. Confirm if this is done in-house.

From the founder’s desk

“No job is too small and no client too big. Everyone deserves the same care.”

Ashish started Insight Graphics in 1999, after two years in the pharmaceutical industry showed him how much a label carries for a product. What began as pre-press and graphic design work, with Bazaar Kolkata among the first clients, grew into a full print house serving brands like Adani Wilmar, Emami, Alpine Distilleries, Boroline and Jupiter Pharma.

A commerce graduate of The Bhawanipur Education Society College, he has run the business for over 25 years and 1000+ clients. In his words: “We are just getting started.”

We have the leading state of art infrastructure, leading technology and equipments; and trained professionals across India
